name: MCP Action Firewall
description: A transparent proxy that intercepts high-risk tool calls and requires OTP-based human approval before they can be executed. It acts as a configurable circuit breaker between AI agents and target MCP servers to prevent unauthorized or dangerous actions.

rawRecord.description: A transparent proxy that intercepts high-risk tool calls and requires OTP-based human approval before they can be executed. It acts as a configurable circuit breaker between AI agents and target MCP servers to prevent unauthorized or dangerous actions.

name.description: Activates per-server rules from your config. Without it, only global rules apply.

config.description: Custom config file path. Without it, uses firewall_config.json in your current directory, or the bundled defaults.

target.description: The full command to launch the real MCP server. This is the server you want to protect (e.g., 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github').

verbose.description: Turns on debug logging (written to stderr, won't interfere with MCP traffic).
